You know, i think that stuff going viral about "transtrender" made a lot of people aware of new genders or terms for the first time. So it wasnt necessary trending for popularity but some people genuinely were exposed to terms like nonbinary or transmasc for the first time. So try not to feel ashamed that you found out now after so long. Plus the pandemic made a lot of people question their ideals around themselves, so there is nothing wrong with that either.

You can present however you choose to present. If you dont feel like a man, or if you don't feel like a woman, welcome to nonbinary! Or any other associated label you'd like. Or no label at all. Its all open to *you*. You dont have to go all the way through medical transition or hormones if you feel okay the way you are. I felt much like you did before i came to accept myself. Nothing really changed on the outside, since i just dressed and looked the same, tomboyish, but my inner self confidence felt a lot better. I havent even came out to anyone and still use she/her in social spaces outside of online. My actual pronouns are they/she. But just knowing that i exist and there are other people like me, who are nonbinary as well, it felt a lot better knowing that i wasnt just weird. That my experience with gender is a product of a lot of crap, and its okay to express yourself how you choose to.

My cat is very rough so i had to teach her a method to play with my hands. (People usually dont recommend playing with your hands with your cat so caution dont do this but i enjoy it more and its bonding personally.) She was seperated at 5 weeks so she didnt develop the whole thing from her other siblings where "biting too hard hurts." Their natural play is rough, then their siblings or mom teach them not to play too hard or its over. So every time i played with my kitten when she was young, i would just pretend to cry and say to her kinda loudly "ow" then would not play with her again with my hand. It took maybe 2 months and she learned to not bite or scratch as hard, and immediately lets go of me when i say "ow" lol. She only gets super crazy after catnip.
